10.content:
# claude.md - Quest ES Event Request - Create (MOCK, 2026-10-15)

Unlinked memory node. MOCK built from Brent's request after the 2026-10-15 Quest call (transcript
not yet processed in Spiky when this was built -- confirm field list against the call).

## Purpose
Generic agent form that CREATES a new ES_Event_Request__c in Quest's Salesforce (UAT sandbox via
data source cx_actions) through a Salesforce Connected Object, instead of the agent creating the
record in Salesforce first.

## Node map
- 1 Content  New Event Request (ROOT) -- intake form, all fields req_* (NOT sf_*). -> 2
- 2 Script   Validate & Format -- date -> YYYY-MM-DD, time -> HH:MM:SS.000Z shifted to Central
             (same rule as Post Collection node 913), state/zip/phone cleanup, OSM -> email. -> 3
- 3 Content  Review & Submit -> 9 | Edit -> 1
- 9 Scoring  cr_is_valid == true -> 4 | 3
- 4 Data     CO 505 create_sf_event_request (cx_actions, CREATE ES_Event_Request__c) -> 5
- 5 Script   Read result -> cr_created, cr_record_id -> 6
- 6 Scoring  cr_created == true -> 7 | 8
- 7 Content  Created (shows SF id)
- 8 Content  Failed -> Retry 4 | Edit 1
- 10 Content claude.md (this node)

## Connected Object 505 (built 2026-10-15; Salesforce connector, source cx_actions, CREATE, ES Event Request)
Alias: create_sf_event_request. Field -> value:
  Event_Type__c = ${req_event_type} (picklist: Post Accident / Reasonable Suspicion -- confirm values)
  Date_of_Incident__c = ${cr_date_of_incident}            (Date)
  Time_of_Incident_Actual__c = ${cr_time_of_incident}     (Time, HH:MM:SS.000Z)
  Airport_Code__c = ${req_airport_code}
  Event_Address__c / Event_City__c = ${req_event_address} / ${req_event_city}
  Event_State__c = ${cr_event_state} (Text 2)  Event_Zip__c = ${cr_event_zip} (Text 5)
  Contact_Name__c = ${req_contact_name}  Contact_Phone__c = ${cr_contact_phone}
  Contact_Email_Address__c = ${cr_contact_email}  Member_ID_Number__c = ${req_member_id}
  Donor_Name__c / Donor_ID__c / Donor_Job_Title__c = ${req_donor_name} / ${req_donor_id} / ${req_donor_job_title}
  Number_of_Donors__c = ${cr_number_of_donors}             (Number)
  Additional_Notes__c = ${req_notes}
  Company__c (lookup) = 001WE00001DI8TlYAL (Delta Air Lines Account, UAT sandbox ONLY -- remap per env)
  RecordTypeId = 0124Q000001dXHUQA2 (Delta Event Request; without it SF defaults to ES 24/7 -- remap per env)
  Response: response.code, response.data.success / id / errors[{fields,message,errorCode}] (node 5).
  OPEN: record type, owner, status defaults and required-on-create fields unconfirmed -- first live
  run will surface them in node 8's error text.

## Conventions
- Never sf_*-name a field here: the ZTree SF package would try to write it to the launching record.
- Typed SF fields (Date/Time/Number) only via the Connected Object, pre-formatted in node 2.


TEST LOG 2026-10-15 (preview 966502799, Quest UAT sandbox)
Event-00215516 a37WE000003Ow7ZYAS: wrong record type (ES 24/7), fixed by adding RecordTypeId to CO 505.
Event-00215517 a37WE000003OwAnYAK: Delta Event Request; Airport blank (scripted dropdown fill failed, not the CO).
Event-00215518 a37WE000003OwCPYA0: PASS, all mapped fields saved incl. Airport MSP, Time 3:30 PM, Member ID, Job Title.
Gap: Time_of_Incident_Time_Zone__c not mapped (time sent as Central).
All three records are test data, safe to delete.
Run 2 (validation path): bad date blocked Submit; Edit kept values; fixed date -> Event-00215519 a37WE000003OycPYAS (RS, 9:00 ET -> 8:00 CT). PASS.
Run 3 (error path): 300-char address -> HTTP 400 STRING_TOO_LONG shown on node 8; Edit Request -> shortened -> Event-00215520 a37WE000003Oym5YAC (14:00 PT -> 4:00 PM CT, blank donors -> 1). PASS.
Fix: node 5 now reads 4xx errors from _zt_meta.response.body (was printing raw JSON).

## Changelog (CR-001, 2026-10-29 -- Fahim/Chris "ZingTree Observations" 10/28)
- Node 1: Call Date (date picker) + Call Time (15-min select, Central); Voicemail Received Yes/No + conditional
  Voicemail Received Time; Date of Incident is a date picker; Time of Incident is a 15-min select;
  "(9 digits)" on Supervisor OSM Number and Donor ID (custom_regex, blank allowed); new Supervisor Job Title,
  Supervisor Department Number, Donor Department Number; Specimen Requested (required) + 2 optional extras.
- Node 2 stages cr_call_date (YYYY-MM-DD), cr_call_time / cr_voicemail_time (HH:MM:SS.000Z, entered in Central),
  cr_voicemail_received ('Yes'/'No') + cr_voicemail_received_bool, cr_specimens (';'-joined for a multi-select picklist).
- CO 505 MUST ADD (Connected Object config, outside this export): Call_Date__c=${cr_call_date},
  Call_Time_Actual__c=${cr_call_time}, Voicemail_Received__c=${cr_voicemail_received} (or _bool if checkbox),
  Voicemail_Received_Time__c=${cr_voicemail_time}, Type_of_Specimen_Requested__c=${cr_specimens},
  Manager_Job_Title__c=${req_supervisor_job_title}, Department_Number__c=${req_supervisor_department_number},
  Department__c=${req_donor_department_number}. Field types of Voicemail_* and whether Type_of_Specimen_Requested__c
  is multi-select are unconfirmed.

## Changelog (CR-002, 2026-10-30 -- Quest x Zingtree Project Sync 10/29 + Chris 10/29 notes)
- Node 1: Additional Specimen fields start on "None" (they defaulted to Hair); node 2 ignores "None".
- Node 5: success screen adds an "Open Event in Salesforce" button (cr_record_url; sandbox host, remap on promotion).
- Root cause of Chris's 10/29 gaps (job title, dept numbers, call date/time, voicemail, time zone, specimens not in SF):
  CO 505 maps none of the CR-001 fields yet. Add: Call_Date__c=${cr_call_date}, Call_Time_Actual__c=${cr_call_time},
  Voicemail_Received__c=${cr_voicemail_received}, Voicemail_Received_Time__c=${cr_voicemail_time},
  Type_of_Specimen_Requested__c=${cr_specimens}, Manager_Job_Title__c=${req_supervisor_job_title},
  Department_Number__c=${req_supervisor_department_number}, Department__c=${req_donor_department_number},
  Time_of_Incident_Time_Zone__c=<SF picklist value for Central> (time is sent converted to Central).
